notes.title: Valgrim Bug fix for Valgrim Boss fight
notes.notes:
Valgrim reaper boss was crashing when hit during his phase transition. This is fixed.
UI now snaps to buttons when initial opening a dialogue.
Dialogue was skipping some lines at times as if the button was being pressed twice on the controller. Fixed!

notes.title: Demo Update: Boss Adjustments and an audio glitch
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who's tried the Blightened demo so far and especially those of you who gave honest, brutal feedback. It helps.

This update includes:

Visual polish to tighten up bugs and inconsistencies

Boss tweaks to make the fight more readable and fair

Minor visual cleanup

This is still early, but I’m here, working, and paying attention.
If you played the first version and walked away, I invite you to try again.
If you’re just jumping in now welcome. I am open to any and all feedback. 

best,
Chris
Xombis
